The [[Scepter of the Hierophant]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]].

==Acquisition==
;[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**[[Slavers' Exile]]
***[[Hierophant's Chest]]

==Stats==
:[[Dark Damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:Halves Skill recharge of spells (Chance 10%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while Health is above 50%)

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Mallyx's Malice]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Vulnero's Curse]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Cold damage]] and requires [[Curses]].
*[[Terob's Wand]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts Cold damage and requires [[Death Magic]].
* [[Imperial Dragon Wand]], [[The People's Will]] and [[Xun Rao's Justice]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Fire damage]] and require [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
* [[Plague-Soaked Stave]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires Divine Favor, Soul Reaping, Fast Casting, Energy Storage, or Spawning Power.
